L7·N658unmasked layer
Fires at sentence-boundary positions — the first word of a new sentence right after a period (typically function words like "The", "In", "At", "This") — rather than on any semantic content; notably the same surface forms in other contexts drive the neuron strongly negative, so it appears to encode a signed sentence-onset/discourse-continuation signal at these tokens.
